---
title: "Analyst Factsheet"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
brand:
  color:
    palette:
      paper: "#FFFFFF"
      ink: "#22282E"
      red: "#C10016"
      blue: "#0F4C81"
    background: paper
    foreground: ink
    primary: blue

  # No font is named, so the page keeps Bootstrap's stack of the sans-serif
  # fonts every system has, and nothing is fetched from a font service.
  typography:
    headings:
      weight: bold
      color: red
toc: true
toc-depth: 4
execute:
  error: true
---

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, fig.height=4}
# The path to the config file, whose esef section names the Silver layer of
# the module. A chunk runs with the directory of this template as its working
# directory, which is inside the installed package, so the path is taken from
# the environment variable FINCOMMONS_CONFIG where it is set and is otherwise
# a paths.yaml beside the template.
config_path <- Sys.getenv("FINCOMMONS_CONFIG", "paths.yaml")

# The issuer, by its LEI. This is voestalpine AG; any other issuer whose
# country the esef pipeline has collected can be put here.
lei <- "529900ZAXBMQDIWPNB72"

# The number of financial years shown, counted back from the latest filing.
n_years <- 6

# Amounts are shown in millions of the currency of the report.
scale <- 1e6

# You can change the language of the figures here, but they must be
# implemented for each figure separately by you. The language also picks the
# filing: an issuer that files its report in English and in German has two
# filings per year with the same figures, and the texts are taken from the
# one in the language of the factsheet where there is one. voestalpine has
# filed in German only since its report for 2021/22, so its texts are German
# whatever the language set here.
lang <- "en"

# The month names in the captions come from the system locale rather than
# from the language set above, so the locale for dates is set from lang.
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", if (lang == "de") "German" else "C"))

# The concepts the factsheet is built from. Only concepts of the IFRS
# taxonomy are used. An issuer may tag a line of its statements with a
# concept of its own instead, but an extension concept is the issuer's to
# name and rename from one year to the next. A figure that is not in the
# taxonomy is derived from those that are, in the next chunk, or left out.
# The key is what the code below refers to, so a concept can be swapped for
# another issuer's presentation without touching the figures.
#
# A key may be given more than one concept, in order of preference, for an
# issuer that changed the tag of a line: voestalpine tags its property, plant
# and equipment as PropertyPlantAndEquipment up to 2024/25 and with the
# right-of-use assets in the concept's name since, and its earnings per share
# for 2020/21 as basic and diluted in one.
concepts <- c(
  assets = "ifrs-full:Assets",
  noncurrent_assets = "ifrs-full:NoncurrentAssets",
  ppe = "ifrs-full:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentIncludingRightofuseAssets",
  ppe = "ifrs-full:PropertyPlantAndEquipment",
  goodwill = "ifrs-full:Goodwill",
  current_assets = "ifrs-full:CurrentAssets",
  inventories = "ifrs-full:Inventories",
  receivables = "ifrs-full:TradeAndOtherCurrentReceivables",
  cash = "ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents",
  equity = "ifrs-full:Equity",
  equity_owners = "ifrs-full:EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent",
  noncurrent_liabilities = "ifrs-full:NoncurrentLiabilities",
  current_liabilities = "ifrs-full:CurrentLiabilities",
  financial_liabilities_noncurrent = "ifrs-full:OtherNoncurrentFinancialLiabilities",
  financial_liabilities_current = "ifrs-full:OtherCurrentFinancialLiabilities",
  equity_and_liabilities = "ifrs-full:EquityAndLiabilities",
  revenue = "ifrs-full:Revenue",
  cost_of_sales = "ifrs-full:CostOfSales",
  gross_profit = "ifrs-full:GrossProfit",
  distribution_costs = "ifrs-full:DistributionCosts",
  admin_expense = "ifrs-full:AdministrativeExpense",
  ebit = "ifrs-full:ProfitLossFromOperatingActivities",
  profit_before_tax = "ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax",
  income_tax = "ifrs-full:IncomeTaxExpenseContinuingOperations",
  profit = "ifrs-full:ProfitLoss",
  profit_owners = "ifrs-full:ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent",
  eps = "ifrs-full:BasicEarningsLossPerShare",
  eps = "ifrs-full:BasicAndDilutedEarningsLossPerShare",
  dps = "ifrs-full:DividendsProposedOrDeclaredBeforeFinancialStatementsAuthorisedForIssueButNotRecognisedAsDistributionToOwnersPerShare",
  operating_cash_flow = "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities",
  investing_cash_flow = "ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInInvestingActivities"
)

# The texts of the report shown in the profile of the issuer.
text_concepts <- c(
  name = "ifrs-full:NameOfReportingEntityOrOtherMeansOfIdentification",
  legal_form = "ifrs-full:LegalFormOfEntity",
  domicile = "ifrs-full:DomicileOfEntity",
  address = "ifrs-full:AddressOfRegisteredOfficeOfEntity",
  parent = "ifrs-full:NameOfUltimateParentOfGroup",
  activities = "ifrs-full:DescriptionOfNatureOfEntitysOperationsAndPrincipalActivities"
)

# You can adapt your corporate design in the sourced R-Skript
library(ggplot2)
source("r-corporate-design-functions-ggplot2.R")

# The label of a financial year. A year that ends on 31 December is named by
# its calendar year, and any other by the two it spans, as voestalpine's
# financial year from April to March is: 2025/26 ends on 31 March 2026.
fy_label <- function(date) {
  y <- as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  ifelse(format(date, "%m-%d") == "12-31", as.character(y),
         paste0(y - 1, "/", sprintf("%02d", y %% 100)))
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(yaml)
library(arrow)

yaml_paths <- read_yaml(config_path)
path_silver <- yaml_paths[["esef"]][["silver"]]

# The Silver layer may name a schema in a catalogue rather than a directory,
# with the directory the tables are written to beside it. R reads files, so
# it takes the directory.
if (is.list(path_silver)) path_silver <- path_silver[["path"]]

# arrow reads every parquet file under a directory. A Delta table keeps the
# files it has replaced until it is vacuumed, and the table of facts replaces
# a country's partition on every run that finds new reports, so a Delta table
# read this way counts a fact once for every time it was written. The
# factsheet therefore refuses one rather than show those sums.
for (table in c("filings", "facts")) {
  if (dir.exists(file.path(path_silver, table, "_delta_log"))) {
    stop("The ", table, " table of the esef module is a Delta table, which ",
         "this template does not read. Write the Silver layer as parquet, ",
         "or read the table through Spark.")
  }
}

filings_all <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "filings")) %>%
  filter(LEI == lei) %>%
  collect()

if (nrow(filings_all) == 0) {
  stop("The table of filings lists no filing of ", lei, ". The table lists ",
       "every country, so the LEI is likely wrong.")
}

# One filing per financial year. A report filed in two languages, or filed
# again with corrections, is a filing of its own with facts of its own, and
# the figures of the year are taken from one of them: the one in the
# language of the factsheet, then the one with fewer validation errors, then
# the one the repository processed last. A filing without a JSONURL has no
# facts and is never chosen while another one is there.
filings <- filings_all %>%
  arrange(PERIODEND,
          is.na(JSONURL),
          coalesce(LANG, "") != lang,
          coalesce(ERRORS, 0L),
          desc(PROCESSED)) %>%
  group_by(PERIODEND) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(JSONURL)) %>%
  arrange(PERIODEND) %>%
  slice_tail(n = n_years + 1)

if (nrow(filings) == 0) {
  stop("No filing of ", lei, " has facts in the Silver layer. Run the esef ",
       "pipeline for the issuer's country first.")
}

latest <- filings %>% slice_tail(n = 1)
issuer_name <- latest$NAME

facts <- open_dataset(file.path(path_silver, "facts")) %>%
  filter(LEI == lei, FILING %in% filings$FILING) %>%
  collect()

# The figures of a year are the totals the year's own filing reports for the
# year: no dimensions, a period that ends on the period end of the filing,
# and, for a flow, a period that begins a year before it. The comparative
# figures of the previous year that every filing carries as well are left
# aside, so that a restated figure does not stand beside the one first
# reported without saying so. The same fact may be tagged more than once in
# a report, in the statements and again in the notes, with the same value.
figures <- facts %>%
  filter(is.na(DIMENSIONS), !is.na(VALUE), PRDEND == PERIODEND,
         is.na(PRDSTART) | PRDSTART == PERIODEND - 364 |
           PRDSTART == PERIODEND - 365) %>%
  distinct(PERIODEND, CONCEPT, UNIT, VALUE) %>%
  group_by(PERIODEND, CONCEPT) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

currency <- figures %>%
  filter(CONCEPT == concepts[["assets"]]) %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  pull("UNIT") %>%
  sub("^iso4217:", "", x = .)
if (length(currency) == 0) currency <- ""

# One row per year, one column per key of the concepts above, from the first
# of a key's concepts the year's filing tags. A concept the issuer did not
# tag stays a column of missing values, so that the figures below show a gap
# rather than fail.
wide <- figures %>%
  inner_join(tibble(key = names(concepts), CONCEPT = unname(concepts),
                    preference = seq_along(concepts)),
             by = "CONCEPT") %>%
  group_by(PERIODEND, key) %>%
  slice_min(preference, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(PERIODEND, key, VALUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "key", values_from = "VALUE") %>%
  arrange(PERIODEND)
for (key in setdiff(unique(names(concepts)), names(wide))) {
  wide[[key]] <- NA_real_
}

# The figures the statements do not carry under a concept of the taxonomy.
# voestalpine presents its income statement by function: revenue less cost
# of sales is gross profit, and gross profit less distribution and
# administrative costs, other operating expenses and plus other operating
# income is the operating result, which it calls EBIT. Other operating
# income and expenses are taken together as what is left between gross
# profit and EBIT, so that the uses of revenue add up to revenue.
#
# Net debt is the financial liabilities less cash. voestalpine tags its
# borrowings and lease liabilities as other financial liabilities, current
# and non-current; another issuer may tag them as borrowings, and the
# concepts above are then the ones to change.
wide <- wide %>%
  mutate(year = fy_label(PERIODEND),
         other_operating = gross_profit - coalesce(distribution_costs, 0) -
           coalesce(admin_expense, 0) - ebit,
         assets_other_noncurrent = noncurrent_assets - coalesce(ppe, 0) -
           coalesce(goodwill, 0),
         assets_other_current = current_assets - coalesce(inventories, 0) -
           coalesce(receivables, 0) - coalesce(cash, 0),
         financial_liabilities = financial_liabilities_noncurrent +
           financial_liabilities_current,
         liabilities_other_noncurrent = noncurrent_liabilities -
           coalesce(financial_liabilities_noncurrent, 0),
         liabilities_other_current = current_liabilities -
           coalesce(financial_liabilities_current, 0),
         net_debt = financial_liabilities - cash,
         free_cash_flow = operating_cash_flow + investing_cash_flow,
         # The ratios. The return on equity puts a flow against the average
         # of two balances, which the first year shown takes from the year
         # before it; that year is read for this and then dropped.
         gross_margin = gross_profit / revenue * 100,
         ebit_margin = ebit / revenue * 100,
         net_margin = profit / revenue * 100,
         roe = profit_owners / ((equity_owners + lag(equity_owners)) / 2) * 100,
         equity_ratio = equity / assets * 100,
         gearing = net_debt / equity * 100,
         tax_rate = income_tax / profit_before_tax * 100,
         payout = dps / eps * 100)

if (nrow(wide) > n_years) wide <- wide %>% slice_tail(n = n_years)

max_date <- max(wide$PERIODEND)

texts <- facts %>%
  filter(FILING == latest$FILING, !is.na(TEXT), is.na(DIMENSIONS)) %>%
  inner_join(tibble(key = names(text_concepts),
                    CONCEPT = unname(text_concepts)), by = "CONCEPT") %>%
  arrange(key, coalesce(LANG, "") != lang) %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
text_of <- function(key) {
  value <- texts$TEXT[texts$key == key]
  if (length(value) == 0) NA_character_ else value
}

# Numbers are written as the language of the factsheet writes them.
big_mark <- if (lang == "de") "." else ","
decimal_mark <- if (lang == "de") "," else "."
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "",
         formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = big_mark,
                 decimal.mark = decimal_mark))
}

# A caption wider than the figure is clipped rather than wrapped, so it is
# broken into lines once here.
wrap_caption <- function(text, width = 95) {
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}

# The source line in the wording of the corporate design.
source_caption <- caption_corporate_design(
  source = if (lang == "de") "ESEF-Finanzberichte, filings.xbrl.org." else
    "ESEF annual financial reports, filings.xbrl.org.",
  last = format(max_date, if (lang == "de") "%d.%m.%Y" else "%d %b. %Y"),
  lang = lang)

amount_label <- if (lang == "de") paste0("Mio. ", currency) else
  paste0(currency, " million")

# The x-axis of every chart has one break per financial year, named as the
# tables name it.
scale_x_years <- function(...) {
  scale_x_date(expand = c(.01, 0), breaks = wide$PERIODEND, labels = fy_label,
               ...)
}
```

Generated on `r format(Sys.Date(), if (lang == "de") "%d.%m.%Y" else "%d %b. %Y")`.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
viewer <- if (is.na(latest$VIEWERURL)) "" else
  paste0("[", if (lang == "de") "Bericht ansehen" else "View the report",
         "](https://filings.xbrl.org", latest$VIEWERURL, ")")

temp <- tibble(
  item = c("LEI", "Legal form", "Domicile", "Registered office",
           "Ultimate parent", "Latest report", "Language of the report",
           "Validation errors and warnings", "Report"),
  value = c(lei,
            text_of("legal_form"),
            text_of("domicile"),
            text_of("address"),
            text_of("parent"),
            format(latest$PERIODEND, "%d %b. %Y"),
            coalesce(latest$LANG, ""),
            paste0(coalesce(latest$ERRORS, 0L), " / ",
                   coalesce(latest$WARNINGS, 0L)),
            viewer))

if (lang == "de") {
  temp$item <- c("LEI", "Rechtsform", "Sitz", "Anschrift", "Oberste Muttergesellschaft",
                 "Letzter Bericht", "Sprache des Berichts",
                 "Validierungsfehler und -warnungen", "Bericht")
  temp$value[6] <- format(latest$PERIODEND, "%d.%m.%Y")
}

knitr::kable(temp %>% filter(!is.na(value), value != ""),
```

## Key figures

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
rows <- tribble(
  ~key,                  ~en,                                ~de,                                        ~digits,
  "revenue",             "Revenue",                          "Umsatzerlöse",                             0,
  "gross_profit",        "Gross profit",                     "Bruttoergebnis",                           0,
  "ebit",                "Operating result (EBIT)",          "Betriebsergebnis (EBIT)",                  0,
  "profit_before_tax",   "Profit before tax",                "Ergebnis vor Steuern",                     0,
  "profit",              "Profit after tax",                 "Ergebnis nach Steuern",                    0,
  "profit_owners",       "Profit attributable to owners",    "Den Eigentümern zurechenbares Ergebnis",   0,
  "assets",              "Total assets",                     "Bilanzsumme",                              0,
  "equity",              "Equity",                           "Eigenkapital",                             0,
  "equity_owners",       "Equity attributable to owners",    "Den Eigentümern zurechenbares Eigenkapital", 0,
  "net_debt",            "Net debt",                         "Nettofinanzverschuldung",                  0,
  "operating_cash_flow", "Cash flow from operating activities", "Cashflow aus der Betriebstätigkeit",    0,
  "free_cash_flow",      "Free cash flow",                   "Free Cashflow",                            0
)

temp <- wide %>%
  select("year", all_of(rows$key)) %>%
  mutate(across(-"year", ~ fmt(.x / scale))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-"year", names_to = "key") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "year", values_from = "value") %>%
  left_join(rows, by = "key") %>%
  mutate(item = if (lang == "de") de else en) %>%
  select("item", matches("^[0-9]{4}"))

knitr::kable(temp, col.names = c(amount_label, names(temp)[-1]),
             align = paste0("l", strrep("r", ncol(temp) - 1)))
```

### Ratios

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# The page shows numbers and the texts of the filing, and no prose of its
# own, so what a reader of the template needs to know about a figure is said
# in the comments of its chunk.
#
# The ratios are computed from the figures above and are not the issuer's own
# key performance indicators, which a report states in its management report
# and often defines differently. voestalpine's own gearing, for one, takes
# net financial debt from its notes, which also nets other financial assets
# against it. The return on equity puts the profit of a year against the
# average of the equity at its start and its end.
rows <- tribble(
  ~key,           ~en,                                ~de,                                    ~digits,
  "gross_margin", "Gross margin, %",                  "Bruttomarge, %",                       1,
  "ebit_margin",  "EBIT margin, %",                   "EBIT-Marge, %",                        1,
  "net_margin",   "Profit after tax to revenue, %",   "Ergebnis nach Steuern zu Umsatz, %",   1,
  "roe",          "Return on equity, %",              "Eigenkapitalrendite, %",               1,
  "equity_ratio", "Equity to total assets, %",        "Eigenkapitalquote, %",                 1,
  "gearing",      "Net debt to equity, %",            "Nettofinanzverschuldung zu Eigenkapital, %", 1,
  "tax_rate",     "Effective tax rate, %",            "Effektive Steuerquote, %",             1,
  "eps",          paste0("Earnings per share, ", currency),
                  paste0("Ergebnis je Aktie, ", currency), 2,
  "dps",          paste0("Dividend per share proposed, ", currency),
                  paste0("Vorgeschlagene Dividende je Aktie, ", currency), 2,
  "payout",       "Payout ratio, %",                  "Ausschüttungsquote, %",                1
)

temp <- wide %>% select("year", all_of(rows$key))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
  temp[[rows$key[i]]] <- fmt(temp[[rows$key[i]]], rows$digits[i])
}
temp <- temp %>%
  pivot_longer(-"year", names_to = "key") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "year", values_from = "value") %>%
  left_join(rows, by = "key") %>%
  mutate(item = if (lang == "de") de else en) %>%
  select("item", matches("^[0-9]{4}"))

knitr::kable(temp, col.names = c("", names(temp)[-1]),
             align = paste0("l", strrep("r", ncol(temp) - 1)))
```

## Balance sheet

### By type of asset

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, fig.height=4}
temp <- wide %>%
  select("PERIODEND", "ppe", "goodwill", "assets_other_noncurrent",
         "inventories", "receivables", "cash", "assets_other_current") %>%
  pivot_longer(-"PERIODEND", names_to = "var") %>%
  mutate(value = value / scale)

var_levels <- c("ppe", "goodwill", "assets_other_noncurrent", "inventories",
                "receivables", "cash", "assets_other_current")

# Default is English
var_labels <- c("Property, plant and equipment", "Goodwill",
                "Other non-current assets", "Inventories",
                "Trade and other receivables", "Cash and cash equivalents",
                "Other current assets")
y_label <- amount_label

if (lang == "de") {
  var_labels <- c("Sachanlagen", "Firmenwerte", "Sonstige langfristige Aktiva",
                  "Vorräte", "Forderungen aus Lieferungen und Leistungen und sonstige Forderungen",
                  "Zahlungsmittel", "Sonstige kurzfristige Aktiva")
}

temp <- temp %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = var_levels, labels = var_labels))

ggplot(temp, aes(x = PERIODEND, y = value, fill = var)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_years() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) fmt(x)) +
  scale_fill_corporate_design() +
  labs(caption = wrap_caption(source_caption), subtitle = y_label) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_corporate_design(axis.title = element_blank())
```

## Income statement

### What revenue was spent on

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, fig.height=4}
# The parts add up to revenue: cost of sales and gross profit are revenue,
# and gross profit is spent on distribution and administration and on other
# operating expenses net of other operating income, with EBIT left over. A
# year in which other operating income exceeds the expenses has a negative
# bar for them, below the axis.
temp <- wide %>%
  select("PERIODEND", "cost_of_sales", "distribution_costs", "admin_expense",
         "other_operating", "ebit") %>%
  pivot_longer(-"PERIODEND", names_to = "var") %>%
  mutate(value = value / scale)

var_levels <- c("cost_of_sales", "distribution_costs", "admin_expense",
                "other_operating", "ebit")

# Default is English
var_labels <- c("Cost of sales", "Distribution costs",
                "Administrative expenses", "Other operating expenses, net",
                "Operating result (EBIT)")
y_label <- amount_label

if (lang == "de") {
  var_labels <- c("Umsatzkosten", "Vertriebskosten", "Verwaltungskosten",
                  "Sonstige betriebliche Aufwendungen, netto",
                  "Betriebsergebnis (EBIT)")
}

temp <- temp %>%
  mutate(var = factor(var, levels = var_levels, labels = var_labels))

ggplot(temp, aes(x = PERIODEND, y = value, fill = var)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_zeroline() +
  scale_x_years() +
```

## Checks on the data

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# The figures are the issuer's tags, as filed, and a tag can be wrong while
# the report a reader sees is right: the scale of a number is an attribute of
# the tag, invisible on the page. The checks put figures of the same report
# against one another, each of which the statements state as the sum of the
# others: total assets as the non-current and current assets, total equity
# and liabilities as the equity and the non-current and current liabilities,
# the two totals as one another, and revenue as the cost of sales and the
# gross profit. A difference points at a tag to look at in the report before
# the figure is used.
#
# The flag is set before the figures are formatted, since it compares them.
# It is meant for a tag with the wrong scale or the wrong sign, and not for
# rounding, so it is set where a difference exceeds a thousandth of the
# total assets.
checks <- wide %>%
  mutate(diff_assets = assets - noncurrent_assets - current_assets,
         diff_liabilities = equity_and_liabilities - equity -
           noncurrent_liabilities - current_liabilities,
         diff_balance = assets - equity_and_liabilities,
         diff_revenue = revenue - cost_of_sales - gross_profit) %>%
  transmute(year,
            flag = ifelse(pmax(abs(diff_assets), abs(diff_liabilities),
                               abs(diff_balance), abs(diff_revenue),
                               na.rm = TRUE) > assets / 1000,
                          if (lang == "de") "prüfen" else "check", ""),
            flag = coalesce(flag, ""),
            across(starts_with("diff_"), ~ fmt(.x / scale, 1)))

extension <- facts %>%
  filter(FILING %in% (filings %>% filter(PERIODEND %in% wide$PERIODEND))$FILING,
         !is.na(VALUE)) %>%
  group_by(year = fy_label(PERIODEND)) %>%
  summarise(facts = n(),
            extension = fmt(mean(!startsWith(CONCEPT, "ifrs-full:")) * 100, 1),
            .groups = "drop")

temp <- checks %>%
  left_join(extension, by = "year") %>%
  select("year", "facts", "extension", "diff_assets", "diff_liabilities",
         "diff_balance", "diff_revenue", "flag")

col_names <- c("Year", "Numeric facts", "Extension concepts, %",
               paste0("Assets less non-current and current assets, ", amount_label),
               paste0("Equity and liabilities less their parts, ", amount_label),
               paste0("Assets less equity and liabilities, ", amount_label),
               paste0("Revenue less cost of sales and gross profit, ", amount_label),
               "")
if (lang == "de") {
  col_names <- c("Jahr", "Numerische Fakten", "Erweiterungskonzepte, %",
                 paste0("Aktiva abzüglich lang- und kurzfristiger Aktiva, ", amount_label),
                 paste0("Passiva abzüglich ihrer Teile, ", amount_label),
                 paste0("Aktiva abzüglich Passiva, ", amount_label),
                 paste0("Umsatz abzüglich Umsatzkosten und Bruttoergebnis, ", amount_label),
                 "")
}

knitr::kable(temp, col.names = col_names, align = "lrrrrrrl")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
temp <- filings_all %>%
```
